title: The P-ring property ascends along quasi-finite maps
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the property that a formal fibre has P ascends along a quasi-finite map of Noetherian rings, and consequently that the P-ring property ascends along quasi-finite maps. The proof records the easy implications among the three statements, then uses the product decomposition of the completion after base change along a quasi-finite map to write the target formal fibre as one factor of the base changed completion, and applies the permanence conditions (A) and (B) to transport the property from the source formal fibre to that factor.
